name: operating_sites
note: Operating clinker-producing cement sites. Summary count calculated from the dataset: Global Energy Monitor, Global Cement and Concrete Tracker, July 2026 (V1) release, CC BY 4.0 (https://globalenergymonitor.org/creative-commons-license).

name: sites_at_least_1mtpa
note: Operating sites with reported clinker capacity of at least 1 Mtpa (million tonnes a year). Calculated from the same dataset.

name: sites_unknown_capacity
note: Operating sites with no reported capacity. Calculated from the same dataset. Unknown means not published; these sites are kept in the TAM.

name: listed_monthly_fee
note: TrustRadius listing for Braincube "Basic", re-checked 13 November 2026. A different product; unit and scope not established. Using it as the fee for this market is an assumption.

name: subscriptions_per_site
note: One site-wide subscription per site. The real contract unit is not public.

name: unknown_capacity_share_qualifying
note: Neutral 50% prior for sites of unknown size clearing the 1 Mtpa filter. Not measured.

name: readiness_share
note: Illustrative 70% technical, data and integration readiness among size-qualified sites. No census.

name: first_reachable_pool
note: First model: pool of reachable sites over three years. Analyst capacity test, not identified prospects.

name: first_qualified_year1
note: First model: sites qualified in year 1. Analyst workload case.

name: first_qualified_year2
note: First model: sites qualified in year 2.

name: first_qualified_year3
note: First model: sites qualified in year 3. Limited by the remaining pool.

name: first_win_rate
note: First model: share of qualified sites that go live, rounded down to whole sites.

name: first_slots_year1
note: First model: delivery slots in year 1.

name: first_slots_year2
note: First model: delivery slots in year 2.

name: first_slots_year3
note: First model: delivery slots in year 3.

name: first_retention
note: First model: share of the new cohort kept each year. Analyst guess; replaced in the corrected model.

name: corrected_proposals_per_year
note: Corrected model: proposals a year, reasoned from assumed sales workload. Not an observed pipeline.

name: corrected_engagement_pool
note: Corrected model: sites that can reach proposal over three years (3 × 8). Does not bind.

name: corrected_win_rate
note: Corrected model: proposal-to-contract rate. Norwest reports 31–50% for half of respondents; 40% chosen near the band centre. Not cement data.

name: corrected_live_share
note: Corrected model: share of signed contracts live within the year. Reasoned allowance; not observed.

name: corrected_capacity
note: Corrected model: new deployments a year. Does not bind.

name: corrected_retention
note: Corrected model: gross revenue retention. Benchmarkit median for USD 50k–100k contracts; software benchmark, not cement.

name: physical_kilns
note: Physical kilns at the 2,521 operating sites. Calculated from the same dataset. Includes inactive units; not active or billable units.

name: package_price_current
note: Braincube Real Time Process Optimization, Microsoft Marketplace list price on 16 November 2026, one-year subscription. A different product; list price, not a contract price.

name: package_price_from_2027_03_01
note: Price notice on the same listing: USD 155,000.00 a year from 1 March 2027 (UTC). An announced price, not one observed in use.

name: package_max_sites
note: "The standard package covers up to 10 optimization units across up to 2 sites."

name: package_max_units
note: Same wording. "Optimisation unit" is not defined, so units needed per plant are unknown.

name: package_use_current_2_sites
note: Fee per site = current price ÷ 2. Assumes a customer actually shares one package across two qualifying sites.

name: package_use_current_1_site
note: Fee per site = current price. A customer with one site pays for the whole package.

name: package_use_2027_2_sites
note: Fee per site = price from 1 March 2027 ÷ 2. Assumes a customer actually shares one package across two qualifying sites.

name: package_use_2027_1_site
note: Fee per site = price from 1 March 2027. A customer with one site pays for the whole package.

name: funding_round
note: Series A announced 3 June 2026. Treated as the whole round's investment for this test only; the actual structure, terms and stakes are unknown.

name: stake_series_a_median
note: Carta: median dilution in US software Series A rounds, six months to 10 July 2026. Used as the stake the whole round bought. Not Gigaton's terms.

name: stake_series_a_p25
note: Carta: Series A dilution at the 25th percentile. Used in the unfavourable constructed case.

name: stake_series_a_p75
note: Carta: Series A dilution at the 75th percentile. Used in the favourable constructed case.

name: dilution_series_b_median
note: Carta: median Series B dilution. An assumed later round; not a known plan.

name: dilution_series_b_p25
note: Carta: Series B dilution at the 25th percentile.

name: dilution_series_b_p75
note: Carta: Series B dilution at the 75th percentile.

name: dilution_series_c_median
note: Carta: median Series C dilution. An assumed later round; not a known plan.

name: dilution_series_c_p25
note: Carta: Series C dilution at the 25th percentile.

name: dilution_series_c_p75
note: Carta: Series C dilution at the 75th percentile.

name: dilution_series_d_median
note: Carta: median Series D dilution. An assumed later round; not a known plan.

name: dilution_series_d_p25
note: Carta: Series D dilution at the 25th percentile.

name: dilution_series_d_p75
note: Carta: Series D dilution at the 75th percentile.

name: sale_multiple_low
note: SEG 2Q26: median sale value of acquired SaaS companies, 4.0 times revenue over the past twelve months. Software sales, not Gigaton.

name: sale_multiple_high
note: Analyst upper sensitivity. Not a SEG range endpoint.

name: sale_multiple_premium
note: Rounded from 14.90 times FY2024 revenue in the AspenTech buyout. A separate premium case, outside the 4–10 times range. One deal, not a typical multiple.

name: return_multiple_low
note: Illustrative return. Industry Ventures discusses 3x on later-stage winners; context, not any investor's target.

name: return_multiple_high
note: Illustrative return. Industry Ventures discusses 10x-plus on early-stage winners; context, not any investor's target.

name: market_share_low
note: Share of the serviceable market won. No benchmark found; a sensitivity only.

name: market_share_high
note: Share of the serviceable market won. No benchmark found; a sensitivity only.
